answer: After each work round, the protocol draws an unpredictable jury and secretly inserts flawed canary tasks: a false nebula calculation, an unsafe willow survey, or a corrupted river reading. Reviewers who coordinate verdicts or approve a canary lose their identities and accrued rewards. An attacker controlling 100 Sybils must keep every account audit-ready; one planted-junk approval can erase the participating cluster and forfeit all rewards it spent rounds earning.
